product_analysis.product_type: Privacy-focused offshore infrastructure reseller platform (Domains, Offshore cPanel Hosting, VPS, Windows RDP, Private Email, Developer API, Crypto Wallet)
product_analysis.benchmark: Dynopay.com (editorial clarity, high-contrast light-first canvas, indigo accents, monospace metadata tags, generous whitespace, sandbox/test badges, multi-step card checkout)
product_analysis.target_audience: Developers, offshore entrepreneurs, privacy enthusiasts, system admins, crypto-native founders

user_journey_flows.domain_purchase_flow: 1. Search query on hero -> 2. Instant inline domain search table with TLD pills & price -> 3. Add to Cart / Configure WHOIS Privacy & Nameservers -> 4. Enter Multi-Step Checkout inside App Shell (Configure -> Review -> Wallet Pay -> Instant Activation Receipt)
user_journey_flows.vps_rdp_provision_flow: 1. Select Region (EU / Singapore) -> 2. Select Spec Tier (vCPU, RAM, SSD) & OS -> 3. Choose Billing Cycle (7-day test / Monthly / Annual) -> 4. Multi-Step Checkout Stepper -> 5. Instant credentials reveal modal + active server management card
user_journey_flows.wallet_topup_flow: 1. Check wallet balance chip in TopBar -> 2. Open Wallet modal or page -> 3. Select Preset Amount ($20, $50, $100, $250) -> 4. Choose Crypto (BTC, ETH, USDT, SOL) -> 5. Generate DynoPay payment link/QR -> 6. Real-time balance refresh on confirmation

editorial_indigo.name: Option 1: Editorial Indigo & Obsidian (Dynopay Benchmark Default)
editorial_indigo.concept: Clean, light-first public canvas with deep obsidian dark mode. Features editorial display headlines, high contrast Indigo accents, crisp 1px borders, monospace technical metadata tags, and elevated single-card focus areas.

geometry_and_styling.border_radius: rounded-xl for cards, rounded-lg for inputs/buttons, rounded-full for pills
geometry_and_styling.shadows: shadow-sm for flat cards, shadow-lg shadow-indigo-500/5 for interactive elements

key_issues: App shell navigation redundancy across AppRail.jsx, sidebar.jsx, and topbar.jsx consuming ~380px horizontal space.
Data tables displaying raw string noise ('test_mode', 'Invalid Date') without defensive fallback handling.
Button utility class fragmentation (btn-blue, btn-teal, add-to-cart) causing inconsistent border-radii.
Transparent overlay backgrounds in header/dropdown menus causing text bleed over underlying page content.
Missing data-testid attributes across interactive domain/hosting/wallet elements.

general_ui_ux_guidelines.header_and_overlays: DO NOT use complete transparent backgrounds in headers, dropdowns, or overlays. Always use glassmorphism (backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/80 dark:bg-gray-900/80) or solid backgrounds with subtle 1px borders.
general_ui_ux_guidelines.testing_attributes: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a kebab-case data-testid attribute (e.g. data-testid='hero-domain-search-input', data-testid='checkout-pay-button').
general_ui_ux_guidelines.typography: Use Plus Jakarta Sans / Outfit (.js format components) for display headlines. Avoid Inter for main titles. Use JetBrains Mono for technical IDs, prices, and status tags.
general_ui_ux_guidelines.colors_and_contrast: Primary brand color is Indigo (#4F46E5 / #6366F1). Restrict Amber (#F59E0B) strictly to sandbox/test mode or warning states. Ensure all text meets WCAG AA 4.5:1 contrast standards.
general_ui_ux_guidelines.defensive_rendering: Never display raw unformatted strings like 'Invalid Date' or 'test_mode' in data tables. Fall back gracefully to '—' or styled status badges.

instructions_to_main_agent: Refer to /app/design_audit.md for page-by-page audit findings and specific recommended fixes.
When modifying React .js components in /app/frontend/src/, ensure all interactive elements retain or add kebab-case data-testid attributes.
Ensure headers and dropdown menus never use transparent backgrounds without backdrop blur and border separation.
Prioritize fixing data formatting in DomainList.jsx, Wallet.jsx, and OrderHistory.jsx.
